IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging: High latency detected for MerchantCorp (dedicated VPC pool apac-southeast1). p95 and p99 trending upward. Pager to on-call team.
Eli (oncall): I'm on it. seeing alerts for p95 ~980ms, p99 ~2.4s across the APAC ingress AZs. Any customer traffic changes?
Maya (infra): Confirmed. Metrics from the dedicated pool show queued requests and a KSAT spike around 08:12 UTC. GPU utilization at 98% on pool-gpu-3.
Priya (sre): Can we confirm whether this is tenant-wide or specific job types? MerchantCorp reported large batch replays earlier?
Jorge (eng-runtime): Looking at the request tags — spike mostly on merchant-embed and long-chat endpoints. Sequence lengths elevated. Seems like KV cache miss rate jumped.
Eli (oncall): Tagging MerchantCorp CIDs: mc-421, mc-422. Nina, can you ping the customer to see if they pushed anything?
Nina (cust-succ): Reached out to MerchantCorp support contact (Alex). He says they rolled a ruleset at 07:58 UTC that backfills embeddings for a segment; might be replaying many long contexts.
Priya (sre): That explains long sequences. Immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle MerchantCorp traffic at routing layer, 2) scale dedicated pool with burst capacity, 3) fallback certain routes to hosted compatible model. Thoughts?
Maya (infra): Reserved burst capacity is available but will take ~3min to spin up new nodes due to image pull. Draining small tenants off this pool is possible via routing policy.
Jorge (eng-runtime): Fallback to hosted model variant (lower-cost quantized) is compatible for embeddings and short chats. For long-chat we risk quality regression. We can set a per-route policy: embed requests -> fallback hosted; long-chat keep local but throttled.
Eli (oncall): Let's do triage: immediate 1) apply rate-limit on merchant-embed route to 40% of baseline to protect p99, 2) trigger burst scale to +2 nodes, 3) open temporary fallback for embed to hosted. Execute in that order.
Priya (sre): I'll apply a token-based throttle via routing policy now.
Priya (sre): /routing update --tenant mc-421 --route merchant-embed --qps 40
OpsBot: Command accepted. Routing policy updated for mc-421 merchant-embed.
Priya (sre): Throttle applied. Observability dashboards show queue length decreasing slightly.
Maya (infra): Starting burst scale action to add 2 g4dn nodes to dedicated pool. ETA ~3:10.
Jorge (eng-runtime): Applying fallback policy for embeddings to hosted endpoint. Will add header X-Redwood-Fallback: hosted-embed-v1.
Eli (oncall): Apply fallback and monitor error rate / semantic diff alerts. Notify me when hosted sees traffic.
Jorge (eng-runtime): Fallback live. Hosted gets initial 12% of embed traffic. Quality metrics pending.
Nina (cust-succ): MerchantCorp replied: they paused the backfill job at our request. They will leave it paused for now but want us to avoid dropping requests.
Priya (sre): Great. Now we need to keep p99 under SLO while preserving customer requests. Watching p95—it's down to 520ms; p99 around 1.1s.
Maya (infra): Burst nodes are coming up. Node g4dn-09 joined pool at 08:17:09 UTC, g4dn-10 at 08:18:52 UTC. Utilization dropping to 76%.
Eli (oncall): Nice. Please confirm KV cache warmup status for the pool.
Jorge (eng-runtime): KV cache miss rate was high; after fallback/warmup it's improving. Applying proactive pre-warm for top prefixes seen in merchant requests:
```
# prewarm script
prewarm --pool dedicated-apac --prefixes "mc-421/session,mc-422/context" --parallel 8
```
Jorge (eng-runtime): Prewarm kicked off. Estimated 90s to hit hit-rate improvement.
Priya (sre): Monitoring shows p99 sliding back to ~650ms. We'll keep the throttle for another 10 minutes, then gradually relax.
Nina (cust-succ): Alex at MerchantCorp appreciates the update. He's asking for a postmortem and whether we can provide a temporary SLA credit.
Eli (oncall): We'll capture impact numbers. Priya, can you pull the request count and P99 impact window?
Priya (sre): Will do. Initial estimate: 2.3k requests delayed > p99 threshold between 07:58–08:16 UTC. Correlating with throttle/fallback timings for accurate impact.
Maya (infra): Note: one worker had OOM errors in logs at 08:10 UTC, likely due to unusually long sequences. We patched config to reject sequences > 64k tokens for merchant-embed route as emergency guard.
Eli (oncall): Good catch. Jorge, did that config change require rollback if false positive?
Jorge (eng-runtime): It's a hard limit only for this tenant route right now. We'll keep it until MerchantCorp confirms backfill is paused and we observe stable metrics.
Nina (cust-succ): MerchantCorp asks for timeline to fully restore normal throughput. Can we estimate?
Maya (infra): With current nodes and cache warmed, 5–10 minutes to relax throttle fully if they don't resume heavy jobs.
Eli (oncall): OK. I'll hand off to Priya for follow-up postmortem and to Nina for customer comms. If anything regresses, ping me directly.
Priya (sre): Handoff acknowledged. I'll compile timeline, root cause (customer backfill + KV miss + OOM config gap), mitigations, and action items.
Nina (cust-succ): I'll draft a customer-facing summary and propose a goodwill credit. Tagging legal for SLA review after postmortem.
Eli (oncall): Quick checklist before I drop: 1) remove emergency seq-length reject only after confirmation, 2) add routing guard to detect large replay-like patterns, 3) evaluate prewarm automation for dedicated pools.
Jorge (eng-runtime): Adding an automatic replay-detection rule to trigger prewarm and temp fallback in the flow. Will raise PR with config later today.
Maya (infra): I'll add a playbook entry for merchant-style backfills to ops runbook.
Priya (sre): Postmortem draft will include numbers and a recommended SLO credit calc. Targeting initial draft in 2 hours.
Nina (cust-succ): Customer update sent: "We're paused and grateful. Please keep us posted."
Eli (oncall): Thanks everyone. Closing the active war room. If anything else shows, reopen thread. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident marked as mitigated by Eli (oncall) at 08:31:07 UTC. Severity: Sev2.
Eli (oncall): Adding one final note — follow-up action item: coordinate with MerchantCorp to provide a controlled backfill pattern next week (staggered batches + smaller sequence windows).
Priya (sre): Noted. Will add to action items.
Nina (cust-succ): I'll set up a sync with MerchantCorp for Monday.
OpsBot: War room closed. Logs and artifacts archived to /incidents/2165501234/"
